select concat(c.name_path, '/', bm_weigh_centre.name) from bm_weigh_centre left join (select b1.id, b1.name, b1.id_path, group_concat(b2.name order by b2.id separator '/') as name_path from bm_weigh_centre_category b1 left join bm_weigh_centre_category b2 on find_in_set(b2.id, b1.id_path) and b2.is_deleted = 0 where b1.is_deleted = 0 group by b1.id) c on bm_weigh_centre.category_id = c.id where bm_weigh_centre.id = #{weighCentreId}
